calls.statement:
SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_distinct
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY start_date

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h) AS holdout_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS targeted_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h JOIN t USING(member_id)) AS overlap,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS holdout_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_id IS NULL) AS null_ids,
 (SELECT holdout_size FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id=15) AS dim_holdout_size,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) AS bak_rows
